rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a violent explosion or blast.

example.english: There was an explosion nearby just now, and it scared me.
example.traditional: 頭先附近有爆炸，嚇到我呀。
example.jyutping: tau4 sin1 fu6 gan6 jau5 baau3 zaa3 haak3 dou2 ngo5 aa3

rows.note: Use this for a sudden, uncontrolled increase, expansion, outbreak, or bursting out rather than a literal blast.

example.english: There’s an explosion in flu cases lately, so everyone wears masks outdoors.
example.traditional: 呢排流感爆發，大家出街都戴口罩。
example.jyutping: ni1 paai4 lau4 gam2 baau3 faat3 daai6 gaa1 ceot1 gaai1 dou1 daai3 hau2 zaau3

rows.note: Use this specifically when referring to the sound produced by an explosion.

example.english: I heard the sound of an explosion and was so scared that I shook all over.
example.traditional: 我聽到一陣爆炸聲，嚇到成個人震晒。
example.jyutping: ngo5 teng1 dou2 jat1 zan6 baau3 zaa3 seng1 haa5 dou3 seng4 go3 jan4 zan3 saai3
